name: edgegde_registry.set_tenant_layout
description: Set or update a tenant's layout design. Defaults to staging environment. If the payload is identical to the current latest, no new version is created (idempotent). Returns version number and staging/production URL.

tenant_id.description: The tenant identifier (hostname or tenant slug)

version_note.description: Optional human-readable note for this version

name: edgegde_registry.rollback_layout
description: Rollback a tenant's production layout to a previous version. Updates the production:latest pointer only. Does NOT delete version history.

name: edgegde_registry.promote_to_production
description: Promote a specific staging version to production. Copies the staging:latest pointer to production:latest after acquiring a deploy lock.

version.description: Staging version to promote (e.g. 'v5'). If omitted, promotes whatever staging:latest points to.
